aggregation.method: asset pixel, nearest valid pixel on nodata
aggregation.why: An asset is a point, so the pixel it stands on is the reading that describes it. Where that pixel is nodata we step outward to the nearest valid pixel and record the distance in pixel_offset_rings. A neighbourhood max (physrisk's get_max_curves_on_grid) answers a different question -- is there data near here -- and gives a port the flood depth of the nearest tidal flat.
